newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Light names Kadoorie chairman.
newsitem.headline: China Light names Kadoorie chairman.

text.p: China Light & Power Ltd said on Sunday that its chairman Sidney Gordon would retire from its board effective December 17 and will be succeeded by senior vice chairman Michael Kadoorie.

Vice chairman Piers Jacobs will become senior vice chairman, and his place will be filled by director Dickson Leach, also effective December 17 following the company's annual general meeting the previous day.
Director G.R. Ross will also retire from the board.
Gordon became chairman of China Light in 1992, succeeding the late Lord Kadoorie.
Michael Kadoorie, the son of the late Lord Kadoorie, is also chairman of Hongkong and Shanghai Hotels Ltd.

Piers Jacobs was Financial Secretary of the Hong Kong government from 1986 to 1991, and joined China Light's board in 1992. Dickson Leach, who is also chairman of Tai Ping Carpets International Ltd, was named a director in 1978.
